en: Dependent on a state with internal object that is a root-cause, there arises a state with external object that is not a root-cause, by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Under root-condition: six; ... [and so on] ... under prenascence and repetition: two; ... [and so on] ... under non-disappearance: six.

Dependent on a state with internal object that is not a root-cause, there arises a state with external object that is not a root-cause, by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Under root-condition: two; ... [and so on] ... under non-disappearance: two.
